description: Find files/folders under a path by name, type, extension, size or date in one walk. Filters are ANDed. Returns {total, hasMore, items [{path, type, size?, mtime?, sha1?}], walk {complete, fromCache, skipped?}}; walk.complete=false means matches may be missing. Cached 5 min; refresh=true re-reads; skips .git/node_modules. After 25 s returns partial:true and keeps walking; call again. With PROTON_DRIVE_INDEX=1 a saved index may answer first (stale:true); repeat the call or pass refresh:true.

glob.description: Name pattern, e.g. *.pdf (* ? **). A pattern containing '/' matches the path relative to `path` (no leading slash), e.g. Docs/*/*.pdf.

modifiedAfter.description: ISO date (original mtime, else upload time).

sort.description: Default name; size and mtime sort descending.

name: drive_search
title: Search files
